visual.general_description: Line chart of serum phosphate and HBV-DNA against months of antiviral treatment, with a strip marking TDF treatment and TDF withdrawal with switch to ETV.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart on a white background with two series over months of antiviral treatment. The left axis is Serum phosphate (mg/dl) with ticks printed 0, 0,5, 1, 1,5, 2, 2,5, 3, 3,5 and 4 (decimal commas). The right axis is HBV-DNA (IU/ml) with ticks printed 0 and 20.000.000 up to 180.000.000 (dot thousand separators). The horizontal axis is titled Months of antiviral treatment with ticks 0, 5 and 7. A dashed line with small circle markers (legend: Serum phosphate) has printed data labels 2,7 at month 0, 1,9 at month 5 and 3,7 at month 7; it falls from month 0 to month 5 and then rises to month 7. A solid thick line (legend: HBV-DNA) starts in the upper part of the plot at month 0, falls steeply to the zero baseline at month 5 and stays on the baseline to month 7; no numeric labels are printed on this line. A legend below the plot lists both series. A two-cell strip at the bottom reads TDF-treatment on the left and TDF withdrawal and switch to ETV on the right; its dividing line does not sit exactly beneath a month tick. No patient name, identifier, date, face or photograph is present.
